description:
RE-MEASURE AND LIKELY CLOSE (2026-07-02 state; this description supersedes all prior framing). Original finding (.18.12 audit at 014aa505f): MaterializedExecutable produced 2x per executable on all fixtures — the first production under-filled (empty input/value transport positions) and discarded, an artifact pulled before demand settles.

CURRENT STATE at 0cb890e95: the fz-go4.18.22 demand redesign (SCC-settled demand + epoch-only invalidation) appears to have dissolved most of it — the .18.28 census traces show MaterializedExecutable identical re-productions at 6/364, 7/683, 3/336 on the violator fixtures (vs the near-universal 2x at the original measurement). Earlier post-.18.22 measurements (32/12 at 0810fcb89, pre-rework) conflict; the census at the final commit is the most recent datum.

WORK: re-measure on 00181/00001/00026 with the standard method (per-key produced counts + the identical flag). If 1x-per-executable holds (modulo justified epoch re-materializations with changed payloads), CLOSE as dissolved-by-.18.22 with the measurement. If a remainder exists, its acceptance stands: MaterializedExecutable produced once per executable unless a genuine input revision justifies re-materialization (changed payload required as proof).

comments.text: Re-scoped context: the discarded-placeholder materialization is a PREMATURE-READ symptom of the .18.22 founding defect (artifact reads demand before its SCC settles). Post-.18.22, materialization waits on settled demand by construction — re-measure before implementing; expected to close as subsumed.

Census re-measure at 0cb890e95: MaterializedExecutable identical re-productions are 6/364, 7/683, 3/336 across the violator traces — NEAR-COLLAPSED at this base (the .18.22 epoch gating largely dissolved the placeholder double-production, contradicting the earlier 32/12 measurement at 0810fcb89 pre-rework). Re-measure on 00181 with the standard method and close-as-dissolved if 1x/exec holds; implement only a remainder.

title: First MaterializedExecutable production is a discarded under-filled placeholder (2x per executable)
